title: Coast Guard, Navy rescue 9 kayakers near Fidalgo Island, Wash.
description: A Coast Guard aircrew from Air Station Port Angeles, Wash., hoists a Navy rescue swimmer and two female kayakers after the two kayakers became separated from their group during a kayaking trip near Rosario Beach on Fidalgo Island, Wash. A Navy aircrew from Naval Air Station Whidbey Island Search and Rescue hoisted also hoisted seven children from the group, and all the kayakers were taken to Whidbey General Hospital in good condition. U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Port Angeles.
